name: Chicago Traffic Tracker - Historical Congestion Estimates by Region - 2018-2026

Metadata.Time Period: March 2018 - April 2026, with occasional gaps due to system maintenance and other temporary technical issues.

columns.name: REGION_ID
columns.description: Unique arbitrary number to represent each region.

columns.name: SPEED
columns.description: Estimated congestion level. Although expressed in miles per hour, this value is more a reflection of the congestion level in the region than it is indicative of the average raw speed vehicles are travelling within the region.

columns.name: BUS_COUNT
columns.description: The number of buses used to estimate traffic.

columns.name: NUM_READS
columns.description: Number of GPS probes received(or used) for estimating the speed for that segment.

columns.name: HOUR
columns.description: The hour of the day component of TIME.

columns.name: DAY_OF_WEEK
columns.description: The day of the week component of TIME. Sunday=1

columns.name: RECORD_ID
columns.description: Unique arbitrary number to represent each region.

columns.name: WEST
columns.description: Approximate longitude of the west edge of the region.

columns.name: EAST
columns.description: Approximate longitude of the east edge of the region.

columns.name: SOUTH
columns.description: Approximate latitude of the south edge of the region.

columns.name: NORTH
columns.description: Approximate latitude of the north edge of the region.

columns.name: NW_LOCATION
columns.description: The location corresponding to the intersection of NORTH and WEST in a format that allows for creation of maps and other geographic operations on this data portal.

columns.name: SE_LOCATION
columns.description: The location corresponding to the intersection of SOUTH and EAST in a format that allows for creation of maps and other geographic operations on this data portal.
